content.text: Brunch FE-1175 scope-handoff proof. The selected spec already has accepted upstream anchors: REQ1 is the settled requirement, MOD1 is the settled design module, and CH1 is the settled verification check. Use read_graph in overview mode to inspect existing node codes. Then use present_review_set exactly once to propose one plan-lens scope handoff package that the executor could consume directly. Proposal constraints: create one frontier and one scope; compose the scope under the frontier; link the scope to existing REQ1 with realization, existing MOD1 with composition, and existing CH1 with dependency; use schemaVersion 1, lens "plan", epistemicStatus "asserted", and non-empty grounding/pitch fields; do not call mutate_graph directly; stop after a successful present_review_set so the external Brunch RPC reviewer can approve it.
